system.description:
Replacement legs wired into the spine and nerves; like all bionic limbs they give +2 AP against hits to that location. Common models work just like natural legs.

Poor: Speed is halved (round up), and running requires a Dexterity Test (TN 10), with a failure meaning the character falls once the move ends. Good: grants Fleet of Foot and +2k0 on Athletics and Acrobatics tests to jump or leap. Best adds no further benefit beyond Good.
system.effectText: Poor: Speed halved, Dex TN 10 when running or fall. Good: Fleet of Foot and +2k0 jump/leap tests.
